title: A Quarrel
text: {who} and a crew-mate came to blows over the shift rota. Both of them want the AI to settle it.

choices.label: The AI decides
choices.reply: We rule on the rota. {who} loses. The Devoted call it fair; the Autonomists call it an order.

choices.label: Send it to the colonists
choices.reply: A meeting, a long one. The rota is fixed by morning, by people.

choices.label: Rewrite everyone's shifts
choices.reply: A new rota for the whole colony. Output dips while everyone learns it; the shouting stops.
